method: Live service master seed; 300 past draws and 104 current-rule draws. Replay uses only prior 60 draws. Draw-number coverage is the fraction of the 7 drawn numbers occurring anywhere in the ticket group. It is distinct from a winning ticket. Current-group simulations use 500000 shared uniform draws; fixed-award recovery probabilities are lower bounds and exclude floating awards, promotions and tax.
